Homeopathic & Herbal Remedies.productName: Dr. Herbalist Rosemary & Castor Oil Blend 120 mL (4.06 fl oz), Scalp & Hair Oil with Glass Dropper, External Use
Homeopathic & Herbal Remedies.shortDescription: Dr. Herbalist Rosemary & Castor Oil Blend combines castor seed oil and rosemary leaf oil in one 120 mL (4.06 fl oz) amber glass bottle with a glass dropper for precise application. It is a two-ingredient blend: Ricinus Communis (Castor) Seed Oil and Rosmarinus Officinalis (Rosemary) Leaf Oil, with no preservatives, additives or fillers. For external use as a scalp and hair oil: apply directly to the scalp and massage gently in circular motions, 2 to 3 times a week. Formulated in the USA and made in Pakistan by Hemani, a family herbal house since 1949. Avoid direct contact with eyes. Keep out of reach of children. If pregnant, nursing or under medical care, consult a healthcare professional before use. Discontinue use if irritation occurs. Store in a cool, dry place away from sunlight.
